def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    total_claim_amount = 150000
    total_settlement_expenses = 30000
    reinsurance_claim_coverage = 70000
    reinsurance_expense_coverage = 10000
    discount_rate = 0.05
    discount_periods = 1

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    net_claim_liability = total_claim_amount - reinsurance_claim_coverage
    net_expense_liability = total_settlement_expenses - reinsurance_expense_coverage
    total_net_liability = net_claim_liability + net_expense_liability

    present_value_reserve = total_net_liability / (
        (1 + discount_rate) ** discount_periods
    )

    # Return the reserve rounded to the nearest dollar
    answer = round(present_value_reserve)
    return answer
